result.reason: The added language substantively reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable data return within 30 days, and deletion certification. However, it applies upon termination of any individual Service Option Attachment and requires return and deletion of all Content and Customer data, potentially affecting data and services under attachments that remain active. It should be limited to data associated with the terminated attachment. This overbreadth conflicts with the original clause’s intent that termination of one attachment not affect others.
